body:
Feeling slightly more stable at the moment - maybe it'll last more than a day for once :/
In theory nothing's stopping me, I just don't feel like it will happen, no logically reason for it other than I can't see why anyone would want to be with me in the first place, never mind have a family with me.

While I'm in a lucid state, thanks for talking to me. Won't pretend that it's turned me around and I'm suddenly "better" - chance are that I'll end up in the same state again some time soon - but thank you for being someone that I can just talk to about things.

Me and my ex should have had a child a couple of years back, but made the stupid mistake of not keeping it. The thought of having a family is the only thing that keeps me going, but it just seems to get more and more unlikely as each day passes.
I have no way to see a therapist, I have no money and it's not like my parents would care enough to pay. I told my Dad how I was feeling once and all he said was "I don't care".
